A child of a category in the admin UI.

``type`` says which table the row lives in: "subcategory" for
``product_subcategories`` rows, "category" for nested categories. The
admin UI needs it to know which endpoint to edit/delete the row through.

CategoryChildResponse.title: CategoryChildResponse
CategoryChildResponse.description:
A child of a category, as presented to the storefront.

A category can have children in two ways: rows in ``product_subcategories``
(``type == "subcategory"``) and nested categories, i.e. categories with a
``parent_id`` (``type == "category"``). Both are rendered as children of
their parent; neither may be listed as a primary category.

ImageRenditions.title: ImageRenditions
ImageRenditions.description:
Every stored version of one image.

Show `placeholder` first (tiny, blurred), then the smallest entry in
`sizes` whose width covers the displayed width in pixels, and `full` only
when shown larger than the biggest size (zoom). When the image has no
renditions (SVG, legacy/external URL) `placeholder` and `full` are null and
`sizes` is empty: use `original`. Fall back to `original` if a rendition
fails to load (an older upload whose renditions were never generated).
